notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter and Zaiqa Kitchen apps, version 2.19.3.

Three new things
• Customer names: type a name in Delivery, Customer, or Khata and tap the suggestion. Spelling mistakes are fine
• Kitchen: when a waiter adds items to an order already cooking, only the new items are highlighted with START NEW ITEMS; the old ones are faded as "already cooking"
• Press and hold an item (Admin and Waiter): a number pad opens so you can add, for example, 12 Chaye at once. Sold out is now a confirmed link inside the pad
